card.name: Words just before an apostrophe or quote

modes.label: Inside quoted code or names
modes.description: Partway through a transliterated name or a code string with quotes.

card.writes: It makes quote marks less likely as the next token and favors odd symbols and line-break dashes.
card.plain: It fires on words that are about to be followed by an apostrophe ending or sit beside quotation marks, and it makes a quote mark less likely next.
